title: Vitality Overhaul
description: A survival overhaul that slows hunger drain, replaces sprint stamina with the oxygen bar, and ties health regeneration to your food level.
body:
a mod i was using that changed hunger to a stamina system no longer works and i cant find a good alternative. decided to try to make my own. i do not know java or how to make a mod so i used Claude AI ~~(sue me)~~ to help me through it and im very happy with the results...heres a breakdown of what my _hunger/sprint/health_ overhaul does.

- Sprinting now drains oxygen instead of hunger.
- Hunger now depletes slower than normal.
- Health Regen is now dependent on how full your hunger is. (rate of 100% > 0%)
- Oxygen Regen is now dependent on how full your hunger is. (rate of 100% > 80%)
- respiration enchantment effects oxygen drain from sprinting.

comes with in-game mod menu settings so you can tweak many of these values to your liking.
- Hunger Drain Multiplier
- Oxygen Drain Rate (Sprinting)
- Sprint Cutoff (Bubbles)
- Oxygen Refill Rate
- Underwater Sprint Drain
- Health Regen Multiplier
- health regen hit delay

you still cant sprint when hunger drops to 3 meats.

**if you have any issues i can make an attempt to fix it.
find me on Discord by the same name (**Somnati**)**


> //        ideas i could do in the future.      ///
> 
> Altitude — high mountains have thin air, oxygen refills slower depending on your Y level. 
> 
> Wet — getting caught in rain or swimming makes you wet, slows movement slightly and makes you cold faster if Thermal exists. drying off near fire removes it
